How I work

Four habits behind the results.

Start from the gap

Measure what changed

Keep decisions fair

The problem

The solution

A learning package built from standardized development packages, with the goal of raising knowledge of the standard workflow for key positions in the Development Program (8DP) at UT.

New employees

Existing employees

What changed

Development Program Handbook, 2013

  • A guide for running development for a single key position.

Learning Package for 8DP, 2024

How each competency is built

Case study

Digital Business & Technology · MODA

Learning Guide & Assessment Guide (LGAG)

Two companion guides that turn each competency level into something people can prepare for and assessors can measure.

Organisation
PT Mobilitas Digital Indonesia (MODA), Astra Group
Department
Digital Business & Technology
Period
Aug – Dec 2024 (OJT 2)
My role
Creator, as Human Capital Trainee

What it is

Each competency level, written as an element with key indicators, gets its own measurement. Key indicators must be specific, measurable, reliable and attainable.

The result is two documents. The Assessment Guide also holds the measurement tools, a list of questions and case study examples.

Two guides

Learning Guide

  • A study guide, self-directed or given to the assessee to prepare for assessment.
  • Sources can be internal or external.
  • Level 1: general information, such as books and training.
  • Level 2: procedures, SOPs and guidelines.
  • Level 3: information for analysis, such as data and benchmarks.
  • Level 4: information for improvement and evaluation.
  • Level 5: information for improvement and creating innovation.

Assessment Guide

  • A guide for assessors to prepare the assessment methods and the questions.
  • Evidence of work, such as work documents.
  • Observation-based methods: direct observation, case study, role play, demonstration and simulation.
  • Additional measurement, such as a written or oral Q&A or an interview.

Assessment method matrix

A matrix links each proficiency level, from Understand to Create, to suitable assessment methods, so assessors can choose the right one for each level. Using up to three methods per level is recommended.

Worked example

Programming Skill, Level 1. The indicator is knowing the basic concepts of programming. Learning methods are literature and the W3Schools website, with reference links. The assessment method is an oral or written Q&A, with four sample questions.

Sources

Assessment methods draw on Badan Nasional Sertifikasi Profesi (BNSP) and AHCM. For now the learning guides use external sources, to be replaced by internal sources once knowledge management is in place.

Case study

Digital Business & Technology · MODA

Individual Competency Evaluation (EKI)

A process for evaluating each employee’s competencies against the competency matrix of their position.

Organisation
PT Mobilitas Digital Indonesia (MODA), Astra Group
Department
Digital Business & Technology
Period
Aug – Dec 2024 (OJT 2)
My role
Creator, as Human Capital Trainee

Purpose and scope

Purpose

  • To know each individual’s competence, based on the competency matrix.

Scope

  • All MODA employees.

Reference

  • ISO 9001, Clause 6 on resource management.
  • Sub-clause 6.2.2 on competence, training and awareness.
  • SOP People Development (to be confirmed).

Alignment

  • Feeds the Individual Development Plan.

Workflow

  • 1 · InformHCD informs all departments of the EKI schedule
  • 2 · AssessTwo assessors fill in the EKI: the direct supervisor and the supervisor’s supervisor
  • 3 · StrengthsSupervisors fill in the strength and area-of-development columns
  • 4 · ReviewThe employee reviews the result and fills in the expectation column
  • 5 · SubmitThe result is submitted and saved

What I learned

  • Be extra patient with the government timeline.
  • Understand the team’s needs and expectations up front, and compare them with what a candidate’s CV really shows.
  • Clear candidate criteria matter from the very start.
  • Develop the interns with their own expectations in mind, and manage those expectations.
